sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B. Their diverse sizes make them deployable in environments ranging from high-end phones to laptops and servers, democratizing access to state-of-the-art AI. sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Multi-Token Prediction: All Gemma 4 models (E2B, E4B, 12B, 31B, and 26B A4B) include a dedicated draft model for speculative decoding, enabling significantly faster inference with no quality loss. Parameter sizes and quantization Gemma 4 models are available in 5 parameter sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 31B and 26B A4B.

sources.title: Fine-tuned Models for google/gemma-4-26B-A4B - Hugging Face
Gemma 4 26B A4B — MoE Architecture for Long Context
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 26B A4B is a 26.1B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 128K context window. Only ~4B parameters activate per forward pass, enabling high-throughput inference for long-document tasks on RTX 3090/4090 hardware.
